list.name: scenario
list.label: Сценарий
list.query: SELECT short AS __text, scenario AS __value FROM scenarios ORDER BY ord
list.definition: SELECT short AS __text, scenario AS __value FROM scenarios ORDER BY ord

targets.rawSql: SELECT count(*) AS v FROM runs
SELECT sum(ops) * (SELECT count(*) FROM runs) / count(*) AS v FROM phases WHERE phase = 'measure'

panels.title: Overhead замера, p50
panels.description: Тот же цикл замера с пустой функцией вместо операции

targets.rawSql: SELECT percentile_cont(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY noop_ns) AS v FROM overhead
SELECT max(array_length(string_to_array(trim(both '[]' from cpu), ','), 1)) AS v FROM runs
SELECT 'Python ' || max(python) || ' · SQLite ' || max(sqlite) AS v FROM runs

SELECT s.short AS "сценарий", max(m.latency_us) FILTER (WHERE m.target = 'sql') AS "SQL · sqlite3", max(m.latency_us) FILTER (WHERE m.target = 'orm') AS "ORM · SQLAlchemy" FROM summary m JOIN scenarios s USING (scenario) WHERE m.p = 0.5 GROUP BY s.short, s.ord ORDER BY s.ord

SELECT s.short AS "сценарий", max(m.latency_us) FILTER (WHERE m.target = 'sql') AS "SQL · sqlite3", max(m.latency_us) FILTER (WHERE m.target = 'orm') AS "ORM · SQLAlchemy" FROM summary m JOIN scenarios s USING (scenario) WHERE m.p = 0.99 GROUP BY s.short, s.ord ORDER BY s.ord

panels.title: Во сколько раз ORM медленнее чистого SQL

targets.rawSql: SELECT s.short AS "сценарий", max(latency_us) FILTER (WHERE target = 'orm' AND p = 0.5) / max(latency_us) FILTER (WHERE target = 'sql' AND p = 0.5) AS "по медиане p50", max(latency_us) FILTER (WHERE target = 'orm' AND p = 0.99) / max(latency_us) FILTER (WHERE target = 'sql' AND p = 0.99) AS "по хвосту p99" FROM summary JOIN scenarios s USING (scenario) GROUP BY s.short, s.ord ORDER BY s.ord

panels.title: Доля overhead инструмента в медиане операции
panels.description: overhead (пустая операция в цикле замера) / p50 операции, медиана по прогонам

targets.rawSql: SELECT s.short AS "сценарий", max(m.share_pct) FILTER (WHERE m.target = 'sql') AS "SQL · sqlite3", max(m.share_pct) FILTER (WHERE m.target = 'orm') AS "ORM · SQLAlchemy" FROM (SELECT scenario, target, percentile_cont(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY share_pct) AS share_pct FROM overhead GROUP BY scenario, target) m JOIN scenarios s USING (scenario) WHERE true GROUP BY s.short, s.ord ORDER BY s.ord

SELECT m.label AS "перцентиль", max(m.latency_us) FILTER (WHERE m.target = 'sql') AS "SQL · sqlite3", max(m.latency_us) FILTER (WHERE m.target = 'orm') AS "ORM · SQLAlchemy" FROM summary m WHERE m.scenario = '$scenario' AND m.p <= 0.99 GROUP BY m.label, m.p ORDER BY m.p

panels.title: Распределение по перцентилям (логарифмическая шкала, одна линия на реализацию)
panels.description: x = −log10(1 − p); точки — требуемые перцентили. Все прогоны пары вместе.

targets.rawSql: SELECT nines AS x, latency_us AS "SQL · sqlite3" FROM curve WHERE scenario = '$scenario' AND target = 'sql' ORDER BY nines
SELECT nines AS x, latency_us AS "ORM · SQLAlchemy" FROM curve WHERE scenario = '$scenario' AND target = 'orm' ORDER BY nines
SELECT -log(1 - p) AS x, latency_us AS "SQL · p50…p99" FROM summary WHERE scenario = '$scenario' AND target = 'sql' AND p <= 0.99 ORDER BY p
SELECT -log(1 - p) AS x, latency_us AS "ORM · p50…p99" FROM summary WHERE scenario = '$scenario' AND target = 'orm' AND p <= 0.99 ORDER BY p
SELECT bin_us AS x, share_pct AS "SQL · sqlite3" FROM histogram WHERE scenario = '$scenario' AND target = 'sql' ORDER BY bin_us
SELECT bin_us AS x, share_pct AS "ORM · SQLAlchemy" FROM histogram WHERE scenario = '$scenario' AND target = 'orm' ORDER BY bin_us

SELECT CASE kind WHEN 'read' THEN 'чтение ' ELSE 'запись ' END || label AS "операция", max(latency_us) FILTER (WHERE target = 'sql') AS "SQL · sqlite3", max(latency_us) FILTER (WHERE target = 'orm') AS "ORM · SQLAlchemy" FROM kinds WHERE scenario = '$scenario' GROUP BY kind, label, p ORDER BY kind, p

panels.title: Задержка во времени — SQL · sqlite3 (прогон r00, все фазы)

targets.rawSql: SELECT t_s AS x, latency_us AS "warmup" FROM timeline WHERE scenario = '$scenario' AND target = 'sql' AND phase = 'warmup' ORDER BY t_s
SELECT t_s AS x, latency_us AS "measure · SQL · sqlite3" FROM timeline WHERE scenario = '$scenario' AND target = 'sql' AND phase = 'measure' ORDER BY t_s
SELECT t_s AS x, latency_us AS "teardown" FROM timeline WHERE scenario = '$scenario' AND target = 'sql' AND phase = 'teardown' ORDER BY t_s
SELECT t_s AS x, latency_us AS "скользящая медиана" FROM timeline_median WHERE scenario = '$scenario' AND target = 'sql' ORDER BY t_s

panels.title: Задержка во времени — ORM · SQLAlchemy (прогон r00, все фазы)

targets.rawSql: SELECT t_s AS x, latency_us AS "warmup" FROM timeline WHERE scenario = '$scenario' AND target = 'orm' AND phase = 'warmup' ORDER BY t_s
SELECT t_s AS x, latency_us AS "measure · ORM · SQLAlchemy" FROM timeline WHERE scenario = '$scenario' AND target = 'orm' AND phase = 'measure' ORDER BY t_s
SELECT t_s AS x, latency_us AS "teardown" FROM timeline WHERE scenario = '$scenario' AND target = 'orm' AND phase = 'teardown' ORDER BY t_s
SELECT t_s AS x, latency_us AS "скользящая медиана" FROM timeline_median WHERE scenario = '$scenario' AND target = 'orm' ORDER BY t_s

panels.title: Количество операций по фазам (среднее на прогон)

targets.rawSql: SELECT t.label AS "реализация", max(ops) FILTER (WHERE phase = 'warmup') AS "warmup (прогрев)", max(ops) FILTER (WHERE phase = 'measure') AS "measure (замер)", max(ops) FILTER (WHERE phase = 'teardown') AS "teardown (хвост)" FROM phases p JOIN targets t USING (target) WHERE p.scenario = '$scenario' GROUP BY t.label, t.ord ORDER BY t.ord

panels.title: Время выполнения теста по фазам (среднее на прогон)

targets.rawSql: SELECT t.label AS "реализация", max(duration_s) FILTER (WHERE phase = 'other') AS "setup + калибровка + cleanup", max(duration_s) FILTER (WHERE phase = 'warmup') AS "warmup (прогрев)", max(duration_s) FILTER (WHERE phase = 'measure') AS "measure (замер)", max(duration_s) FILTER (WHERE phase = 'teardown') AS "teardown (хвост)" FROM phases p JOIN targets t USING (target) WHERE p.scenario = '$scenario' GROUP BY t.label, t.ord ORDER BY t.ord

panels.title: Стабильность: отклонение p50 каждого прогона от медианы прогонов
panels.description: Каждый прогон — отдельный контейнер; разброс показывает воспроизводимость условий

targets.rawSql: WITH med AS (SELECT target, percentile_cont(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY p50_us) AS m FROM runs WHERE scenario = '$scenario' GROUP BY target) SELECT 'r' || lpad(repeat::text, 2, '0') AS "прогон", max((p50_us / m - 1) * 100) FILTER (WHERE target = 'sql') AS "SQL · sqlite3", max((p50_us / m - 1) * 100) FILTER (WHERE target = 'orm') AS "ORM · SQLAlchemy" FROM runs JOIN med USING (target) WHERE scenario = '$scenario' GROUP BY repeat ORDER BY repeat
